why: A group is valid when some digit d appears in every member, so the best group for digit d is simply all numbers containing d. Count, for each of the 10 digits, how many numbers contain it, and take the maximum.
hints: Fix the shared digit first. Which numbers can join a group that shares digit d?
All of them that contain d, and nothing else. So the answer is the max over d = 0..9 of the count of numbers containing d.
For each number, take the set of its two digits and increment a counter per distinct digit. O(N).
pitfalls: Count a number like 55 once for digit 5, not twice: use the set of its digits.
Duplicates in the array are separate elements (90, 90, 90 gives 3).
